def player(f):

print("player before:", player(previous_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])

        cells=[j for j in range(17,55) if a[i][j] in 'wg']
        if len(cells)>10: return (i,min(cells),max(cells))
    return None
print("rope:", rope_tip(current_frame))
print({k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','no_impact','gameplay_changed','done','level_completed','game_over']})
